title: 黛安娜·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 银发与额间新月印记相互映衬，弧线分明的银甲勾勒肩部。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Diana is an adult silver-haired Lunari woman with pale skin, light eyes, a crescent-shaped forehead mark, and curved silver armor details. Preserve her focused face and athletic adult proportions in a fully covering high-neck dark blue-purple tunic, opaque trousers, gauntlets, and boots. Her large crescent blade is held lowered beside her body, with its curve separated from her legs and no attack posture.
art_direction.scene: A balanced near-frontal full character, subtle contrapposto if anatomically appropriate, silhouette opening into a large quiet paper field. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: silver white, midnight blue, pale violet, faint amber; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
